Under the company's approved proprietary deployment policy, M-17 must be replaced before any external customer access. transcript.text: I need to flag a legal condition on the privacy side. I have not yet updated the standard privacy language in the launch packet to reflect these binding commitments. Before final authorization for the October 1 external customer availability, the privacy template in the launch packet must be updated to include these restrictions on customer content use and the 30-day deletion requirement.
